description: Derived from AGSC-03-25 and AGSC-05-20: the Expected target kinds cell of `related` reads any but a cluster, at either end, because a cluster is a `skos:Collection`, which AGSC-05-20 keeps out of `skos:related`, and the graph files leave such an edge out. The warning AGSC-E315 is carried by the item that authors the key: `note-a` names the cluster `grp`, and `grp` names the note `note-b`. Near misses that stay silent: `note-c` is related to `note-b` (two notes), and `note-b` uses the cluster (the cell of `uses` reads any, and `asc:uses` is no SKOS relation). The two findings are in slug order.
